responsibility: Implements the runtime portions of the ISO SYSTEM module that generated gm2 code uses for multiword BITSET operations. It owns the concrete algorithms for left/right shifting and rotating arbitrary-size set arrays, using memcpy/memset for whole-word moves and bitwise recombination for partial-word cases, and thus provides the fallback runtime support behind compiler-generated SHIFT and ROTATE operations that exceed a single word.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the runtime implementation side of the SYSTEM pair: it provides the concrete multiword BITSET shift/rotate algorithms declared in SYSTEM.def, rather than defining the module's low-level types, constants, and builtin interfaces.
